name: Modernization lifecycle
summary: The Rationalize, Build and Sustain lifecycle: overview, capability maps, scope maps, activity charts and the Intellio asset map.

templates.purpose: The modernization lifecycle in one view: Rationalize, Build and Sustain, each with four subtracks and a one-line objective, so a client sees the whole program before any phase detail.

slide.title: Modernization runs in [[three phases]]

body.text: Decide what to modernize, in what order, and why it pays back.

Refresh the backlog of next candidates each release
